title: Intercept
description: You are covering another player. All attacks that would be directed towards them are redirected towards you.
smart_description: You are covering [gold]{Covering}[/gold]. All attacks that would be directed towards them are redirected towards you.
notes: Multiplayer power that tracks covered creatures dynamically. The Covering variable is populated with the names of all covered creatures. Modifies incoming powered attack damage multiplicatively by (number of covered creatures + 1). Automatically removed after the enemy's turn ends.
